_README: Intentional parity gaps between demonTD and the DEMON wire contract
this is a deliberate feature gap, not drift). tests/test_contract.py
enforces hygiene: an entry whose subject vanishes from the contract,
or that demonTD actually implements, FAILS the suite — the whitelist
cannot rot into a drift-hider. Glob patterns allowed in knob keys.

commands_not_sent.set_depth: Depth is Init-only in TD (immutable while connected); live depth retune is a UX feature we haven't built, not a parity gap.
commands_not_sent.loop_band: TD's LoopBuffer does its own seam crossfade locally; the loop band isn't exposed as a TD par. Add an encoder + Loopbandstart/end pars to revisit.
commands_not_sent.manual_slot_add: Activation-steering surface (manual slots) not built in TD; the steer_*/man_* knobs would come with it.
commands_not_sent.manual_slot_pop: Activation-steering surface not built in TD; see manual_slot_add.
commands_not_sent.write_audio: Live audio-write ('play into the model') surface not built in TD yet — needs an input-CHOP capture + write flow. Strong candidate feature for a TD op; revisit deliberately, not as a parity patch.

events_ignored.init_ack: Server ack of the SessionConfig handshake; only meaningful when the client opts into telemetry_version, which TD does not send. No payload TD acts on.
events_ignored.manual_slot_count: Slot-count echo for the activation-steering surface TD doesn't implement; see commands_not_sent.manual_slot_add.
events_ignored.audio_written: Ack for write_audio, which TD doesn't send; see commands_not_sent.write_audio.
events_ignored.audio_write_failed: Failure ack for write_audio, which TD doesn't send; see commands_not_sent.write_audio.

handshake_not_implemented.upload_track: TD streams the wired CHOP / file at Connect; there is no pre-stream upload-only flow, so upload_ok/upload_failed never arrive.

config_fields_not_sent.stem_source_mode: The web client sends it only for custom-track stem modes; TD has no stems UX, omitting matches the JS default-fixture path.
config_fields_not_sent.lora_paths: Pod-local filesystem paths resolved server-side; meaningless coming from a TD client.
config_fields_not_sent.backend: Defaults to 'acestep' server-side and TD targets acestep pods only; sending it adds nothing.

config_fields_extra.compression: Adapter-level key the server reads off the raw config dict (not a SessionConfig dataclass field, so not in the contract's config catalog). TD sends 'none' when the vendored zstd fails to load.

knobs_not_streamed.feedback_depth: Init-style feedback depth; TD exposes feedback strength only — depth lives in the Init page Depth par (config), not the continuous stream.
knobs_not_streamed.x0_target: Source-lock target blend requires a source latent workflow TD's Sources page doesn't drive yet.
knobs_not_streamed.steps_override: TD treats steps as Init-only (Steps par in SessionConfig); live steps retune is not exposed.
knobs_not_streamed.sde_amp: TD has no SDE-mode knob swap; the Denoise par streams `denoise` in both modes and the server ignores it under SDE.

config_default_overrides.prompt: TD ships its own demo prompt (dubstep) as the Init prompt; the web installation seeds prompts from config.json `prompts`, not `engine`, so there is no single canonical starting prompt to pin to.

lora_triggers_reviewed.why: src/lora_triggers.py was last re-reviewed against this blob of web/lib/loraTriggers.ts. When the upstream blob changes, re-review the port and bump this SHA.
